messages:
emily_cs: Quick sync — NimbusWorks asked to move their renewal up and switch to annual prepay with a 6% blended discount. They need it done this week. Current ARR $420k. Procurement insists on PO + DPA. Any blockers?

carl_sales: I talked to procurement — they'll sign PO if we accept annual prepay and include the DPA. They asked for a one-time onboarding credit (1 week of priority support). Buyer asked for 6%; sales leadership can approve 5% without exec signoff.

june_legal: I'll prep a redline to attach the DPA and the onboarding credit clause. If Sales pushes for 6% we need VP Sales approval and to add a pricing guardrail clause. I'll upload an initial draft today.

marco_fin: Finance: vendor code NW-900 required. We prefer Net30 but will accept prepay invoicing if PO attached. Also need to confirm revenue recognition for the onboarding credit (deferred revenue?).

fiona_enable: Enablement can deliver a 90-min workshop and a 2-week onboarding plan for priority support. Need a list of technical owners and primary use-cases to tailor curriculum. We'll include a 3-question feedback pulse after week 2.

arjun_se: SE flagged recent token-rate throttles on streaming endpoints. Recommend enabling prefix KV caching and raising worker concurrency for the first two weeks. Adding two-line snippet for runbook.

emily_cs: Action items: @june_legal draft redline + DPA; @marco_fin confirm vendor code and booking notes; @carl_sales confirm whether leadership ok with 5% or needs 6%; @fiona_enable collect contacts.

june_legal: Uploaded redline v1: https://drive.company/contracts/nimbus_dpa_redline. Added clause: "one-time onboarding credit applied as service credit to first invoice; any discount >5% requires VP Sales approval." PTAL.

carl_sales: Sales update — buyer pushing for 6%, leadership will approve 5% immediately. I'll ask buyer if 5% + onboarding credit closes it.

marco_fin: Confirmed vendor code NW-900. Prepay accepted via PO referenced to NW-900. We'll treat onboarding credit as deferred revenue; finance OK but will send ARR impact note.

fiona_enable: Got it. I'll draft the 90-min workshop agenda and feedback pulse. Need tech contact names/emails to schedule.

arjun_se: Runbook snippet to include in onboarding:

```
inference.cache.prefix_kv = true
worker.concurrency = 6
monitor.alert.token_rate > 1500 => scale-up
```

frankly: (oops wrong alias)

emily_cs: small correction - ignore that stray message. Who will send DocuSign once redline is final? @carl_sales or me?

carl_sales: I'll send DocuSign after June posts final redline and Finance confirms PO. ETA tomorrow morning.

june_legal: Final redline posted: https://drive.company/contracts/nimbus_dpa_redline_v2. Updated discount to 5% (per Sales leadership), DPA attached, pricing guardrail included.

carl_sales: Sending DocuSign now -> https://docusign.company/nimbus_xyz (signers: CFO, procurement). Fields: vendor code NW-900, billing cadence: annual prepay. Adding @emily_cs as cc.

emily_cs: Logging renewal in Gainsight and tagging as "early_renewal". Will escalate if signature not complete in 3 business days.

billing_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 6088881268. PO NW-900 received and matched. Invoice terms: annual prepay, Net30 for any exceptions.

fiona_enable: Onboarding scheduled Apr 22 09:30 PT (90min). Agenda + runbook shared. Feedback pulse will be sent 2 weeks post-onboarding.

arjun_se: I'll join the kickoff to run the perf checklist.

emily_cs: Closing loop — contract signed, PO in, onboarding booked. Please drop feedback results here after pulse. Thanks team :tada:
